# Atta e rabi Malik

> Atta e rabi Malik is a web developer based in Lahore, Pakistan, working since 2016. He builds WordPress websites, WooCommerce stores, custom front ends in HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript and React, and Node.js or Express backends. He also offers SEO, content writing and social media marketing, alone or as bundles. Prices are set in Pakistani rupees (PKR) and shown in the visitor's own currency (PKR, GBP, EUR, AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD, EGP).

Contact: amalik8989@gmail.com. WhatsApp +92 334 2267926.

## Services and prices (PKR, starting points)

- Landing page: PKR 25,000, one focused page.
- Starter website: PKR 30,000, WordPress, up to 5 pages, copy included, basic SEO setup.
- Business website: PKR 40,000, WordPress, up to 10 pages, custom layout, forms and speed optimisation.
- E-commerce store: PKR 45,000, WooCommerce, up to 30 products, payment gateway setup. Hosting and domain are not included.
- Custom front end or app UI: from PKR 35,000.
- Node.js API or admin panel: from PKR 45,000.
- Data and media integrations (Supabase, Cloudinary): from PKR 15,000.
- Speed and SEO audit: PKR 15,000, written audit with a prioritised fix list.
- Monthly SEO: PKR 20,000 per month.
- Content writing: PKR 3,000 per article of about 1,000 words.
- Social media marketing: PKR 15,000 per month, 12 posts with captions.
- Maintenance and support: PKR 5,000 per month.

## Bundles (PKR)

- Launch: PKR 45,000 one-time. Starter website, SEO foundation, 4 articles, 12 social posts to kick off.
- Growth: PKR 40,000 setup plus PKR 35,000 per month. Business website, monthly SEO, 4 articles and 12 social posts a month.
- Scale: PKR 45,000 setup plus PKR 60,000 per month. E-commerce store, monthly SEO, 8 articles, 20 social posts and maintenance.
